rationale: PoE branch sums detached output.z_loss into combined_loss, so regularizer has no gradient. Detected by hooking the loss aggregation and asserting every term has requires_grad=True. Borderline numerical vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation because the bug is in how loss terms are combined, not in numerical math. pi_precond=true (only when PoE+z_loss_multiplier active).
